# probe_turret, probe_teleport 1, probe_hitlog 1, probe_hitgrid 1, dedicated 1,

# the --save-turret gunner.
# 
#   COD_VERSION=1.5 COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=32752 PROBE_SECS=230 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1 +set probe_hitlog 1 +set probe_hitgrid 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <1.5 install, stock paks only> --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32752 --probe-team axis --probe-fall --probe-secs 200
